support_policy: 10.0.0 release with the frozen api-v1.4.0 contract on /api/v1. RD remains disabled by default. Remote control payloads prefer direct UDP P2P; an optional UDP TURN relay carries end-to-end DTLS traffic for browser viewers and 10.0.0 hosts, with no TCP fallback. New capabilities require matching 10.0.0 clients and signed host reports; existing 7.0 tunnels remain supported. Back up and test restore before deployment. The release notes and attached acceptance record identify verified and unverified coverage. FRP follows its separate upstream version.
